description: Gumtree Australia is an online classifieds marketplace for buying, selling, and finding local goods, vehicles, property, jobs, and services. Its public site and help center focus on marketplace use, with only a general mention that APIs may exist if made available.
summary: gumtree.com.au exposes a known public MCP server at gt-api.gumtree.com.au; no public REST, GraphQL, or CLI developer surfaces were found in Gumtree Australia’s public documentation.
